design_note: Directional organelle-dynamics fill for Arabidopsis MITOCHONDRION and ER by orthology transfer of conserved biogenesis + core-autophagy machinery from yeast seeds. Net = biogenesis - degradation; degradation_selective from organelle-selective receptors only.

resolver_services.candidate_symbols: ensembl_lookup (genomes MCP, authoritative TAIR symbol->AGI) + mygene.info query_genes (genes-ontologies MCP, taxid 3702)
resolver_services.orthology_confirmation: Ensembl Plants Compara pan-homology (genomes MCP ensembl_homology), Arabidopsis->S.cerevisiae direction (cross-kingdom Compara reachable only from the plant side)

confidence_scheme.high: ensembl_compara ortholog_one2one to the seed yeast ORF
confidence_scheme.medium: ensembl_compara ortholog_one2many/many2many to the seed ORF, OR authoritative TAIR-symbol ortholog (conserved family) with/without Compara paralog hits
confidence_scheme.low: symbol-resolved conserved family, no Compara ortholog call
confidence_scheme.inclusion_rule: AGI kept ONLY if (a) Compara-confirmed to the seed yeast ORF, or (b) resolved via authoritative TAIR nomenclature AND having NO Compara hit to a different yeast gene. A TAIR-symbol candidate whose Compara hits map to a different yeast ORF is assigned to THAT gene, not the tested seed (prevents mis-attribution, e.g. DGL1/AT5G66680 -> WBP1/YEL002C, not OST1/YJL002C). Loci are de-duplicated within each module.

selective_arm_guardrail.rule: Arabidopsis lacks orthologs of the yeast selective autophagy receptors Atg32 (mitophagy) and Atg39/Atg40 (ER-phagy).
selective_arm_guardrail.action: No plant ortholog invented/forced. Degradation modules contain ONLY core ATG machinery (shared_with_bulk_autophagy=True). Selective set = EMPTY (0 genes) for BOTH organelles.
selective_arm_guardrail.consequence: degradation_selective_score is NaN by construction for mito and ER — EXPECTED and correct, identical to plant peroxisome/chloroplast verticals.
selective_arm_guardrail.compara_check: ATG32(YIL146C), ATG33(YLR356W), ATG39(YLR312C), ATG40(YOR152C) yielded no Arabidopsis ortholog under symbol resolution or Compara.

dropped_regulators: bZIP UPR transcription factors (bZIP28/bZIP60) NOT included — lineage-specific/plant UPR regulators, not conserved machinery. IRE1 (IRE1A/B) retained as conserved UPR sensor.
coverage_notes: Symbol-based resolution ceiling: SEC61 alpha channel, SEC61 gamma, SEC62/63, SRP19/68/72, OST4/5, MICOS (Mic10/19/60), and several small TOM/TIM subunits are not indexed under standard symbols in Ensembl Plants/mygene and could not be resolved without hand-typing (prohibited). Captured cores are strong and comparable to prior plant verticals.
